description: Save registration form fields from what the user told you. Only these fields can be set: proposedOption1 (Proposed business name), lineOfBusiness (Line of business (exact CAC picklist entry)), proprietorPhonenumber (Phone number (digits only)), proprietorEmail (Email), proprietorState (State), proprietorLga (LGA), proprietorCity (City), proprietorStreetNumber (Street number), proprietorServiceAddress (Street name / address), proprietorPostcode (Postcode (digits only)), companyState (Company state), companyCity (Company city), companyStreetNumber (Company street number), companyAddress (Company street name / address), companyEmail (Company email). Returns what saved, anything invalid, and what's still missing.
name: update_registration_fields
title: Fill in the registration form
